::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
:: CopySTUModeDefaults.cmd
:: 	Copies a custom default file with defaults to put the DTU-1031
:: 	into "STU mode" to system location where it will be found by the 
:: 	Wacom tablet driver and loaded during driver initialization.
::
:: Params:
:: 	-q = execute in quiet mode
::
:: Notes:
:: 	The result of executing this script is to copy a user custom 
:: 	defaults file to a system location where it can be found and merged
:: 	with existing user defaults by the wacom tablet installer.
:: 	The custom settings copied by this script will disable tablet pen
:: 	and button input except for those applications that have either
:: 	programmed to the Wacom pen and button APIs, or applications that
:: 	have been added through the Wacom tablet control panel.
::
:: 	This functionality is supported by tablet driver 6.3.5 and higher.
::
:: Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
:: All rights reserved.
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

set QUIETOPT=%1

:: This script will set environment params for the file path we need.
call SetWacomUserParams.cmd

if "%USERDEFAULTSFILE%"=="" goto ERRPARAMS
if "%USERDEFAULTSFILEDIR%"=="" goto ERRPARAMS

if NOT EXIST .\%USERDEFAULTSFILE% goto FILENOTFOUND

set XCOPYCMD=XCOPY %USERDEFAULTSFILE% %USERDEFAULTSFILEDIR%
set XCOPYFLAGS=/QYI ^> NUL

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DOCOPY
echo.
echo Copying %USERDEFAULTSFILE% to user location...
set XCOPYFLAGS=/FYI

:DOCOPY
%XCOPYCMD% %XCOPYFLAGS%

goto :EOF

:ERRPARAMS
echo.
echo *********************************************
echo *** ERROR: Did you run SetWacomuserParams?
echo *********************************************
echo.
pause
goto :EOF

:FILENOTFOUND
echo.
echo ********************************************************
echo *** ERROR: .\%USERDEFAULTSFILE%" not found.  
echo ********************************************************
echo.
pause
goto :EOF

Readme_DTU-1031.txt
Scripts to facilitate changing DTU-1031 to STU mode or DTU mode.

Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
All rights reserved.

Last updated: 12/02/2014, RCC
================================================================================
Definitions:

DTU mode:
        DTU-1031 comes up as a normal display tablet, with full use of pen
        and buttons on the desktop and in applications.

STU mode: 
        DTU-1031 comes up with disabled pen and buttons.  Applications that 
        are added via the Wacom tablet Control Panel, as well as applications 
        that implement the Wintab API are enabled to have full pen and button 
        input.

================================================================================
Scripts:

CopySTUModeDefaults.bat  - 
        Copies a custom default file with defaults to put the DTU-1031
        into "STU mode" to a system location where it will be found by the 
        Wacom tablet driver and loaded during driver initialization.
 
RemoveCustomUserDefaults.bat - 
        This script will remove custom user defaults of current user.

RestartDriver.bat - 
        Restart the tablet driver with any custom settings.

        This script removes tablet preferences, merges custom tablet 
        defaults (if any), and restarts the tablet driver.

        The result of executing this script will depend on whether it 
        finds any custom tablet defaults or not.  If custom defaults are
        found, then they will be read in affecting tablet usage.  In
        either case (customizations or not), the tablet preferences will
        be removed, and the driver will be restarted.
 
SetDTUMode.cmd -
        Installs custom settings to put DTU-1031 in DTU mode.

        This script removes tablet preferences, merges custom tablet 
        defaults (if any), and restarts the tablet driver.

SetSTUMode.cmd -
        Installs custom settings to put DTU-1031 in STU mode.

        This script removes tablet preferences, merges OEM custom tablet 
        defaults (if any) with those settings necessary to put the tablet
        in STU mode, and restarts the tablet driver.

================================================================================
Scenarios to use scripts:

[1] Out-of-box, to set to STU mode, the admin can do one of the following: 
    (a) Execute individual copy and restart scripts:
        - Admin executes CopySTUModeDefaults.bat for each user that needs
          the STUMode functionality.
        - Admin executes RestartDriver.bat to silently delete prefs, merge in 
          custom defaults and restart driver.  Prefs will be cleared and the 
          STU mode custom defaults will be found and merged.
        - Reboots the system
        - Tablet is now in STU mode

    (b) Use SetSTUMode:
        - Admin executes SetSTUMode.cmd for current user and reboots
        - Tablet is now in STU mode

	For any additional users, execute CopySTUModeDefaults.bat for each
	user, and sign out/sign in for those users.

 
[2] Out-of-box, to set to DTU mode, the admin can do the following:
    (a) Execute the CD IFE installer

[3] From any state, to set to DTU mode, the admin can do one of the following:
    (b) Execute individual remove and restart scripts:
        - Admin executes RemoveSTUModeDefaults.bat for all users
        - Admin executes RestartDriver.bat to silently remove prefs and 
           restart driver 
        - Tablet is now in DTU mode
 
    (b) Use SetDTUMode:
        - Admin executes SetDTUMode.cmd
        - Tablet is now in DTU mode

	For any additional users, execute RemoveSTUModeDefaults.bat for each
	user, and sign out/sign in for those users.
 
[4] Admin updates driver from web installer:
    (a) To stay in same mode:
      - Execute web installer; no further action is required

    (b) To go to STU mode:
      - Execute CopySTUModeDefaults.bat for each us

@echo off
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
:: RemoveCustomuserDefaults.cmd
:: 	This script will remove all custom user defaults.
::
:: Params:
:: 	-q = execute in quiet mode
::
:: Notes:
:: 	The result of executing this script is to remove all custom user
:: 	tablet defaults, both from the temp defaults area, as well as any
:: 	user defaults from the Tablet\Wacom area.  
::
:: 	This functionality is supported by tablet driver 6.3.5 and higher.
::
:: Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
:: All rights reserved.
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

set QUIETOPT=%1

:: This script will set environment params for the file path we need.
call SetWacomUserParams.cmd

:: ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
:: This removes any STU mode settings that may have been set.
:: Unfortunately, it will also remove any other custom user settings
:: (such as handedness).
if "%USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET%"=="" goto ERRPARAMS

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DELETETABLETUSERDEFAULTS

echo.
echo Removing custom defaults for current user...
echo Deleting %USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET%...

:DELETETABLETUSERDEFAULTS
if EXIST "%USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET%" del /Q /F "%USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET%"

goto :EOF

:ERRPARAMS
echo.
echo *********************************************
echo *** ERROR: Did you run SetWacomuserParams?
echo *********************************************
echo.
pause
goto :EOF

@echo off
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
:: RestartDriver.bat
:: 	Restart the tablet driver with any custom settings.
::
:: USAGE:
::	RestartDriver [-q] [exedir]
::
:: PARAMS:
:: 	-q = execute in quiet mode
::      exedir = optional directory for setup.exe
::
:: Notes:
:: 	This script removes tablet preferences, merges custom tablet 
:: 	defaults (if any), and restarts the tablet driver.
::
:: 	The result of executing this script will depend on whether it 
:: 	finds any custom tablet defaults or not.  If custom defaults are
:: 	found, then they will be read in affecting tablet usage.  In
:: 	either case (customizations or not), the tablet preferences will
:: 	be removed, and the driver will be restarted.
::
:: 	This functionality is supported by tablet driver 6.3.5 and higher.
::
:: Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
:: All rights reserved.
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

set QUIETOPT=

:: If user did not specify a place to look for tablet install files,
:: then use the default location in the installer folder.
set EXEDIR=..

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: This script will set environment params for the file path we need.
call SetWacomUserParams.cmd

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: Make sure the above script actually set some params.
:: if "%USERDEFAULTSFILETEMP%"=="" goto ERRPARAMS
if "%USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET%"=="" goto ERRPARAMS

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: Set script options.
::
:PARSEOPTS
    if "%1"=="%QUIETFLAG%" goto OPTQ
    if "%1"=="%EXEDIRFLAG%" goto OPTD
    goto CONTINUE

    :OPTQ
    set QUIETOPT=%1
    shift
    goto PARSEOPTS

    :OPTD
    shift
    set EXEDIR=%1
    shift
    goto PARSEOPTS

:CONTINUE

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: Make sure that we can find the tools we need.
set PREFUTILEXE=%EXEDIR%\prefutil.exe
set SETUPEXE=%EXEDIR%\setup.exe

if NOT EXIST %SETUPEXE% goto ERRSETUP
if NOT EXIST %PREFUTILEXE% goto ERRPREFUTIL

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DOSETUP

echo.
echo *************************************************************************************
echo WARNING!
echo.
echo     This script WILL remove current user preferences and reinstall the driver. 
echo     Any current user default settings will be preserved.
echo.
echo     This installer will be used: %SETUPEXE%
echo.
echo Proceed?
echo *************************************************************************************
echo.
pause

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: Run installer (setup.exe) in silent mode, which will merge 
:: %USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET% (if found) into file of the same name in 
:: <drive>\program files\Tablet\Wacom, and then will start the driver.  
:: The driver may, or may not prompt to reboot.
::
echo.
echo Merging custom defaults and reinstalling (Hang on, this may take several minutes) ...
echo %SETUPEXE% ^/silent

:DOSETUP
"%SETUPEXE%" /silent

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DOREMOVEPREFS

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: Run prefutil, which will remove current user's prefs.
::
echo.
echo Removing current user prefs ...
echo %PREFUTILEXE% ^/remove

:DOREMOVEPREFS
"%PREFUTILEXE%" /remove

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO :EOF

echo.
echo ****************************************************
echo.
echo       Do a system reboot as soon as possible!
echo.
echo ****************************************************
echo.
pause

GOTO :EOF

:ERRPARAMS
echo.
echo *********************************************
echo *** ERROR: %USERDEFAULTSFILETABLET% not found.  
echo ***
echo ***        Did you run SetWacomuserParams?
echo *********************************************
echo.
pause
goto :EOF

:ERRSETUP
echo.
echo

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
:: SetDTUMode.cmd
:: 	Installs custom settings to put DTU-1031 in DTU mode.
::
:: Params:
:: 	-q = execute in quiet mode
::
:: Notes:
:: 	This script removes tablet preferences, merges custom tablet 
:: 	defaults (if any), and restarts the tablet driver.
::
:: 	This functionality is supported by tablet driver 6.3.5 and higher.
::
:: Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
:: All rights reserved.
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

set QUIETOPT=%1

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: This script will set environment params for the file path we need.
call SetWacomUserParams.cmd

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DOREMOVE

echo.
echo *********************************************************************
echo WARNING!
echo.
echo    This script will remove current user preferences, current custom 
echo    user settings, and restore the tablet to DTU mode pen and button
echo    functionality.  The tablet driver is restarted.
echo.
echo    Any existing WacomTabletDefaults.xml settings are preserved.
echo.
echo Proceed?
echo *********************************************************************
echo.
pause

:DOREMOVE

:: This script will remove current user custom defaults without affecting
:: any OEM custom defaults.
call RemoveCustomUserDefaults.cmd %QUIETOPT%

:: Re-installs driver and removes current user prefs.
call RestartDriver.cmd %QUIETOPT%

@echo off
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
:: SetSTUMode.cmd
:: 	Installs custom settings to put DTU-1031 in STU mode.
::
:: Params:
:: 	-q = execute in quiet mode
::
:: Notes:
:: 	This script removes tablet preferences, merges OEM custom tablet 
:: 	defaults (if any) with those settings necessary to put the tablet
:: 	in STU mode, and restarts the tablet driver.
::
:: 	See WARNING below for a brief description of STU mode.
::
:: 	This functionality is supported by tablet driver 6.3.5 and higher.
::
:: Copyright Wacom Technology, Inc. 2014
:: All rights reserved.
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::

set QUIETOPT=%1

:: -----------------------------------------------------------------------
:: This script will set environment params for the file path we need.
call SetWacomUserParams.cmd

if "%QUIETOPT%"=="%QUIETFLAG%" GOTO DOCOPY

echo.
echo *********************************************************************
echo WARNING!
echo.
echo     This script will remove current user prefs and install custom 
echo     settings to disable DTU-1031 pen and button input on the Windows 
echo     desktop.
echo.
echo     Applications that are added via the Wacom tablet Control Panel,
echo     as well as applications that implement the Wintab API are enabled 
echo     to have full pen and button input.
echo.
echo     All existing OEM custom default settings will be preserved.
echo.
echo Proceed?
echo *********************************************************************
echo.
pause

:DOCOPY

:: Copy custom user defaults to current user's %APPDATA% area
call CopySTUModeUserDefaults.cmd %QUIETOPT%

:: Restart the driver, which will merge OEM custom defaults with current
:: user's custom defaults.
call RestartDriver.cmd %QUIETOPT%

goto :EOF
